All applications

Precision polymers
for drug delivery.

Advanced drug delivery needs precise material control and biocompatibility. Synboli offers tailored polymer solutions for these demands.

Discuss this application

Polymers in
pharma.

Drug-delivery applications require control of adhesion, release and biocompatibility. Synboli describes work on adhesive films, polymeric carriers and degradable delivery systems, including injectable and implant applications.

Acrylates and PVP support adhesion and release in patches, films and oral excipients. Functionalised PEG improves conjugate stability and circulation time. Controlling PLA/PLGA and PCL degradation supports longer-term delivery from injectables and implants.
